headline: Net profits of listed Kuwaiti companies double to 3 1 billion dollars
summary: Net profits of listed Kuwaiti companies doubled to $3.1 billion in the second quarter of 2026, the highest percentage growth rate in the Gulf, according to Kamco Invest.
why: Kuwait's listed companies are a key gauge of the Gulf economy, and their earnings shape the Boursa Kuwait market.
